title: Accounts
emptyBody: Add an account with the + button, or link a bank under More → Bank connections.
closeBody: It moves to Closed accounts and stops counting in your totals. You can reopen it later.
closeBodyConnected: It moves to Closed accounts and stops syncing from the bank. You can reopen it later.
deleteBody: {{name}} and all of its transactions will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

form.name: Name
form.openingBalanceHint: What the account held on the date below. Transactions after it add up from there.
form.amountOwedHint: What you owed on the card on the date below, as a positive number.
form.connectedNotice: This account comes from your bank. You can rename it and change its type; the rest is kept in sync.

history.empty: Not enough history to draw a chart yet.
